seo_title: About Work-Integrated Learning (WIL) — Pioneer Technical Institute
seo_description: Pioneer Technical Institute's Work-Integrated Learning (WIL) programme places trainees with partner employers for real workplace experience before graduation.
seo_keywords: PTI WIL, Work Integrated Learning Uganda, industrial attachment Pioneer Technical Institute

sections.heading: What WIL Is
sections.body: Work-Integrated Learning (WIL) is PTI's structured programme for placing trainees with partner employers — garages, construction firms, hotels, offices, IT companies, and farms — so classroom and workshop skills are tested in a real workplace before graduation.

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: Employers consistently look for graduates who already understand a real workplace: showing up on time, following instructions from a supervisor who isn't their instructor, and working alongside people outside the Institute. WIL builds that experience directly into every course.

sections.heading: Who Takes Part
sections.body: WIL is built into PTI's National Certificate and trade courses as part of the final training period. See How WIL Works and Key Steps in WIL for how a placement is arranged, and Get to Work for what happens after.
